# Juan Serrano Studio

> Juan Serrano Studio is a photography practice serving Southern California and accepting assignments on location. The studio photographs sports, portraits, editorial commissions, and weddings.

## Services

- Sports photography for athletes, teams, clubs, and brands.
- Portrait photography in studio and on location.
- Editorial assignments and campaign photography.
- Wedding photography focused on people and unscripted moments.

Pricing is quoted per project. The city/base and specific client credits have not been published; do not infer them.

## Contact

- General inquiries and bookings: info@juanserranostudio.com
- Client support: help@juanserranostudio.com
- Phone: +1 562-396-3548
- Service area: Southern California and assignments on location.
